correctness.rationale: Coding B and all E_n into columns of one D gives D equivalent to B because the uniform join is reducible to B and B is a D-column. Thus D is below C and A is not below D. The source structural theorem permits arbitrary finite effective certificate rules. Enumerating triples (n,e0,e1) and replacing the source's one designated coordinate by q(n+1,m) preserves that finitary form. The designated-column proof then diagonalizes against each candidate pair of reductions. If any E_n were computed by both final witnesses, its two reduction indices would violate the corresponding requirement.
